header.name: Duplicate Asset with Options from Screen

flow.name: Duplicate Asset with Options from Screen

data.query:
query GetAssetWithDataPoints($assetId: String!) {
  asset(where: { id: { _eq: $assetId } }) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        code
        name
        connectionString
        criticality
        manufacturer
        model
        responsibleTeam
        serialNumber
        status
        subType
        type
        installedAt
        lastPmAt
        nextPmAt
        cellId
        cell {
          id
          code
          name
          lineId
        }
        deviceDriverId
        deviceDriver {
          id
          name
        }
        lineId
        line {
          id
          code
          name
        }
        workcenterId
        workcenter {
          id
          code
          name
        }
        dataPoints {
          edges {
            node {
              id
              code
              name
              displayName
              description
              category
              dataType
              unitId
              unit {
                id
                code
                name
              }
              setPoint
              upperLimit
              lowerLimit
              upperWarning
              lowerWarning
              tolerance
              frequency
              isOnChange
              deadband
              precision
              scaleFactor
              historize
              enabled
              alarmEnabled
              alarmPriority
              isCritical
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

data.dataTransform:
{
  "code": $.code,
  "name": $.name,
  "type": $.type,
  "workcenter": $.workcenter ? $.workcenter.code & ' - ' & $.workcenter.name : '-',
  "line": $.line ? $.line.code & ' - ' & $.line.name : '-',
  "cell": $.cell ? $.cell.code & ' - ' & $.cell.name : '-',
  "status": $.status,
  "copyDataPoints": $.copyDataPoints,
  "dataPointsMessage": $.copyDataPoints ? $string($state.context.dataPointCount) & ' data points will be copied' : 'No data points will be copied',
  "_rawData": $
}
data.titleTransform: "Confirm the Details of the New Asset"

data.messageTransform: "Successfully completed the duplication of Asset " &  $state.context.originalAsset.code & ", and its" & $state.context.dataPointCount & " data points."
"Successfully completed the duplication of Asset " &  $state.context.originalAsset.code & ", you selected NOT to copy its datapoints."
"Shucks something did not go right! Tried to copy Asset:  " &  $state.context.originalAsset.code & ", and its" & $state.context.dataPointCount & " data points."
